notes.title: ALTF4 Play Together!! -2 Player Play Update!-
notes.notes:
[b]ALTF4 Play Together[/b]

Now you can play ALTF4 with two people!
Your friend, your family, your lover. You can run with someone else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39781254/c52bf0dba685aa6b8f2e1f4eeda103e77b7eaa61.png[/img]

It's two knights racing to the finish line.  One to be awarded the title of winner.

If you can do it, I can do it!!
Seeing your opponent running in front of you or behind you can fuel your desire to win and give you tips on how to play the game.

Exciting background music and annoying traps that lead clumsy knights to their death.
Avoid obstacles on upgraded maps and jump first, faster, and higher!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39781254/3071e764928fd23ff44f58d216d185b47ffc20cc.png[/img]

[b]How to play[/b]

Player 1 in red feather uses the keyboard, 
player2 with blue feathers can play via pad.



[b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b]

The ability to stream and play a game with a friend. Only one person needs to own the game.
For more information, please refer to the link below.

notes.title: ALTF4 full version released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39781254/3baf90bbc53293d1db8dd0048780b8974bbdd95e.png[/img]

[h1][b]ALTF4 full version released[/b][/h1]

Hello. I am an ALTF4 developer.

We have good news for users who have been waiting with interest in our game!

November 12th! The full version of ALTF4 is released!!

==================================================

The contents added to the full version are as follows.

[h3][b]Add tutorial[/b][/h3]  - A tutorial map has been added to help you learn the basic controls before entering the game.

[h3][b]Add stage[/b][/h3]  - Story Mode: It consists of a total of 5 stages, and maps decorated according to the concept of each stage are added.
  -Challenge Mode: In the Time Attack Mode, a map that can challenge the ranking is added for each stage of the story mode.
   +Extreme difficulty to be added! Please look forward to the Hell Stage!

[h3][b]Add item function[/b][/h3]  - Various items are added to help clear the map in Story Mode.

[h3][b]Add save function[/b][/h3]  - Continue function is added only for story mode.

[h3][b]Add Dodge (evasion) function[/b][/h3]  - The ability to avoid some traps by Dodge has been added.

==================================================

As various contents were added in line with the release, we [u]decided to slightly raise the price of the package[/u] after careful consideration.
[u]Users who have already purchased through Early Access can enjoy this game without additional purchase.[/u]
In addition, ALTF4 does not plan to add DLC in the future, and content to be added in the future will be presented to users through an update.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the users who have shown a lot of love and interest in ALTF4.
We always listen to your support and opinions and try to grow in a good direction.
ALTF4, which was officially released, is also very interesting and I hope you enjoy it. thank you.

notes.title: ALTF4 정식버전 곧 출시!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39781254/e793a618d0388817e7a6503ddfadd71b18b382b8.png[/img]

[h1][b]ALTF4 정식버전 출시[/b][/h1]

안녕하세요. ALTF4 개발자입니다.

저희 게임에 관심을 가지고 기다려주신 유저분들께 기쁜 소식을 전해드리게 되었습니다!

11월 12일! ALTF4의 정식버전이 출!시! 됩니다!!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

정식버전에 추가된 내용은 다음과 같습니다.

[b][h3]튜토리얼 추가[/h3][/b] - 본 게임에 들어가기 전에 기본 조작방법을 익힐 수 있는 튜토리얼 맵이 추가됩니다.
[b]
[h3]스테이지 추가[/h3][/b] - 스토리 모드 : 총 5개의 스테이지로 구성되어있으며, 단계별 컨셉에 맞춰 꾸며진 맵이 추가됩니다.
 - 도전 모드 : 타임어택 모드로 스토리 모드의 각 스테이지 마다 랭킹에 도전할 수 있는 맵이 추가됩니다.
  +추가예정인 극악의 난이도! 헬 스테이지도 기대해주세요!
[b]
[h3]아이템 기능 추가[/h3][/b] - 스토리모드에서 맵 클리어에 도움이 될 다양한 아이템들이 추가됩니다.

[b][h3]세이브기능 추가[/h3][/b] - 스토리모드에 한하여 이어하기 기능이 추가됩니다.

[b][h3]구르기(회피)기능 추가[/h3][/b] - 몇몇 함정들을 구르기로 회피할 수 있는 기능이 추가됩니다.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

출시에 맞춰 다양한 콘텐츠들이 추가됨에 따라 고심끝에 패키지의 [u]가격을 소폭 상향[/u]하기로 결정하게되었습니다.
[u]기존 얼리 액세스로 구매해주셨던 유저분들은 별도의 추가구매없이[/u] 본 게임을 즐겨주시면 됩니다.
또한 ALTF4는 앞으로도 DLC를 추가할 생각이 없으며, 추후 추가될 콘텐츠는 업데이트를 통해 유저분들께 선보일 예정입니다.

ALTF4에 많은 사랑과 관심을 가져주신 유저분들께 진심으로 감사드리며,
보내주시는 응원과 의견 언제나 귀담아 듣고 좋은 방향으로 성장하려 노력하고 있습니다.
정식출시된 ALTF4도 많이 관심가져주시고 즐겨주시길 바랍니다. 감사합니다.

notes.title: World ranking related notice_Patch plan until official release
notes.notes:
Hello, I am ALTF4 developer.

We sincerely appreciate that many people love the game for a short period of time.

We would like to inform you of the recently added world ranking system news and future game updates.

[h1][b]World ranking system initialization[/b][/h1]
[u][b] Ranking system initialization: A ranking attempt using bugs and hacks has been caught.[/b][/u]

   Security and bug fixes. Most of the top records were judged to be bugs, so the records were inevitably reset. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[h1][b]Story mode addition plan[/b][/h1]

ALTF4 initially wanted to launch a full release with a short early access period and no large content additions. However, thanks to the interest and feedback of many people, we have changed our mind to create more content, and we are planning to create additional content by extending the early access period to between October and November, the end of this year.
Future developments are as follows.

Additional stage production
    -The current map is a time attack mode map, and a new story mode will be created.
    -Story mode consists of clearing several stages in stages.
    -Newly released story mode map with more fun and various pitfalls to make the game interesting.
      It is planned to be deployed, and the difficulty level is expected to be easier than in Time Attack mode.

[h3]-Story mode concept art-[/h3]
